'''Sando's Hired Blasters''' was a large squad of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that assisted the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Sando (smuggler)|Sando]] in her activities. They were versed in both melee and ranged combat.<ref name=":Mask of Darth Nihilus" />
